content.query: dependencies | where name startswith "invoke_agent" | summarize p50=percentile(duration,50), p95=percentile(duration,95) by bin(timestamp, 5m), agent=tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
content.title: p50 and p95 latency per agent (ms)

content.query: dependencies | where name startswith "chat " | summarize input=sum(todouble(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])), output=sum(todouble(customDimensions["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])) by bin(timestamp, 1m), agent=tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.name"])
content.title: Tokens per minute by agent

content.query: dependencies | where name == "verify" | summarize count() by tostring(customDimensions["matchcast.verdict"]), tostring(customDimensions["matchcast.reason_code"])
content.title: Verdicts by reason code

content.query: requests | where name has "/ask" | summarize calls=count(), abstained=countif(tostring(customDimensions["matchcast.abstained"])=="true") by bin(timestamp, 5m)
content.title: Ask: calls and abstentions

content.query: dependencies | where name in ("ocr","translate","synthesize") | summarize calls=count(), characters=sum(todouble(customDimensions["matchcast.characters"])) by bin(timestamp, 5m), name
content.title: OCR calls, translation and speech characters
